item.title: Fugu Max
item.description: Fugu Max, released by Sakana AI on September 11, 2026 alongside its flagship sibling Fugu Ultra v2, isn’t a foundation model in the usual sense. It’s a routing model trained to farm tasks out across a fixed pool of open-weight and specialized models, including NVIDIA’s Nemotron family, and to call instances of itself recursively. Sakana prices it at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, which the company claims is 40 to 60 percent cheaper on output than Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Terra, and Kimi K3.

item.title: Fugu Ultra v2
item.description: Fugu Ultra v2 is Sakana AI’s flagship orchestration model, released September 11, 2026 at $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens for standard context lengths. Rather than being trained as one network, it routes and recombines a pool of open-weight and specialized models under a 1 million token context window. On Chartography, Sakana’s visual-reasoning and data-interpretation benchmark, it scored 48.3 against 27.3 for Anthropic’s Opus 5 and 29.5 for Fable 5.
